model_metadata.purpose: Which pre-ignition conditions make ignition of a reported release more likely
model_metadata.architecture: Dense(16) -> BN -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Dense(8) -> BN -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Dense(1)
model_metadata.optimiser: Adam, learning rate 0.005, weight decay 0.0001, full batch
model_metadata.early_stopping: validation loss, patience 20, at most 300 epochs, best-epoch weights restored

loss_formulation.pos_weight_formula: w = N_neg / N_pos of the fitting part
loss_formulation.loss_mathematical_formula: L(z, y) = (1 - y) * softplus(z) + w * y * softplus(-z)

sample.fire_first_rule: CAUSE_DETAILS contains 'NEARBY INDUSTRIAL, MAN-MADE, OR OTHER FIRE/EXPLOSION AS PRIMARY CAUSE'

protocol.inner_split: fitting / validation / calibration = 70 / 15 / 15 within each training part, stratified
protocol.stratification: Stratified by the ignition label (IGNITE_IND = YES)

baselines.cause_only: ignition rate of each cause in the training part
baselines.logistic_regression: same 38 inputs, unweighted, ridge 0.01 (intercept unpenalised), fitted on the training part
baselines.prior: training-part prevalence given to every test incident (Brier only)

protocol.interval_method: corrected repeated k-fold t interval (Nadeau and Bengio, 2003), 49 df

final_model.note: No separate test set; the cross-validation summary is the performance estimate for this procedure.

pressure.note: Mean over 50 test folds of the AUC drop averaged over 10 shuffles per fold.
